says: The web fork: five corrections that held a space, mended
The web fork: five corrections that held a space, mended (the commit before this one changed nothing)
Imagined before the interface: claims, following, permission, voice and condensation, four functions, and their first instances from the web fork
The paper's licence as a permission
The web fork reaches its declared end

Correction marks mended: utterance 40's split mark made whole, the web fork's first-write words and the lexemes only they reached taken out; the selection fork's fifteen lexemes folded into the lexicon
The log made steps: a type Step, History's entries and the plan's steps its instances, the work since History stopped added as steps of their own; three doubled lexemes made one
What was said, measured and threaded: types Measure and Thread, their wholes, 29 threads from the author's record each measured, the third session kept as it was said, its step in the log

The record marked as a reader marks: 21 passages of the author's words measured, each a whole or a range, none yet owned by a brief; the measure given a range; the third session's fifth utterance kept as it was said, and its meant words holding a space made words
The third session's sixth and seventh utterances kept as they were said, and the variances of a measure held open as a thread
The sessions measured: each session and its highlights, a measure said not to conclude, the wholes given names of their own, and the third session's unkept words kept
Said measured as complementary: its marks say what they add to the briefs, the record measured whole, the measures that repeated their threads let go, two threads raised, and the author's words kept
Briefs the work has overtaken measured stale: 27 marks, each saying what no longer holds and what still does, the prose left as it stands

The brief as a flow and its sections: anything may be mounted in its flow, each reference saying if it holds; its sections read through after; 25 lone links made direct references, a break being only a brief mounted in the flow; the wiki holding Glass alone, so nothing is held twice

A title is the holon's name: 413 titles moved out of their bodies to stand beside the identity, no slug beside them, in the main store's eight types; the index names types alone, a name being unique only within a whole
